policies.uiScope: ownerComponentId nonempty OR nodeId starts with I; includes instances outside component masters.
policies.documentationScope: No owner and non-instance in legacy census: NOT_APPLICABLE; preserve existing typography and geometry.
policies.newTypographyDocumentation: Uses the18 base styles; it was created after this before-census and is validated separately, not fabricated as baseline nodes.
policies.normalization: Only exact zero PIXELS/PERCENT equivalence, float32 numeric encoding, and percent line-height f32(value/100)*100; no nearest-style matching.
policies.decoration: The27 scoped UNDERLINE ranges use four formatting-derived styles with identical base metrics/bindings. Apply the complete style by range; do not restore decoration via a post-assignment setter. Other styles declare NONE.
policies.scaling: The103 scoped fractional ranges keep their documented target recipes with recipeScale=1 and instanceScale preserved, but application is UNRESOLVED_SCALED_LINK. Range assignment of the materialized style can be scaled again by Figma; the principal recipe can retain metrics without an explicit style ID. Do not write these ranges until the linking strategy has independent evidence. expectedScale describes recipe comparison only and is not proof of API application behavior.
policies.application: Logical IDs only. Resolve verified real TextStyle IDs. Apply setRangeTextStyleIdAsync to immutable census intervals; retain existing bindings and component properties. Re-read all consumers after the last write. No per-node early PASS or guessed IDs.
policies.bindings: Preserve semantic identity of node/range bindings; style application must not silently replace specific aliases by numerically equal tokens.
